title: Best Laptop Charger (2026)
summary: The top laptop chargers of 2026 combine high wattage, compact GaN design, and multiple ports, with the Anker Nano Pro, Ugreen Nexode 200W, Ugreen Nexode 65W, Satechi 165W, and Anker Nano 45W standing out.
method: I selected chargers that appear in at least two of the provided sources, prioritizing those highlighted as best or best‑value. The sites used were CNET, Tom’s Guide, and PCMag.
assumptions: Prices are only included when a source lists them; otherwise the price field is null.

products.name: Anker Nano Pro 521 USB-C Charger
why: The CNET review calls it the best compact USB‑C phone charger, noting its fast charging and small footprint.
It’s highlighted as a top pick for users needing a portable, high‑speed charger for laptops and phones.
products.best_for: Travelers and mobile professionals who need a single, lightweight charger for laptops and phones.
products.skip_if: You need a charger with USB‑A ports or higher wattage than 45W.

products.name: UGREEN Nexode 200W 6‑port USB‑C and USB‑A Desktop Charger
why: CNET lists it as the best heavy‑duty charger for gamers or creative pros, featuring six ports and 200W output.
It supports multiple laptops and peripherals simultaneously.
products.best_for: Gamers, content creators, and office setups needing simultaneous charging for several laptops.
products.skip_if: You need a portable charger for travel.

products.name: UGREEN Nexode 65W Charger
why: Tom’s Guide praises its compact GaN design and three ports, noting it cuts down on bulky chargers.
It offers a balance of power and portability for laptops and phones.
products.best_for: Students and travelers who need a single charger for a laptop and a phone.
products.skip_if: You require more than 65W or a desktop‑style charger.
